units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 1:8">Targ. Lam. I, 8</cite> <he>ורְתִיעַת</he> (Ar. <he>ורַתְעַת</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 20:15">Targ. Y. I Ex. XX, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Song of Songs 2:5">Targ. Cant. II, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Deuteronomy 19:6">Targ. Y. II, Deut. XIX, 6</cite> (Y. I <he>ירתח</he>; h. text <he>יחם</he>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 2:3">Targ. Lam. II, 3</cite>.
Ib. I, 13 אַרְתִּיעַנִי קדל קדם וכ׳ ed. Lag. (in oth. ed. קדם omitted) he made me turn my back in fear before &c.; (Ar. רַתְּעַנִי, Pa.).—Part. pass. מַרְתַּע excited, trembling.
<cite ref="Eruvin 67a:4">Erub. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>מַרְתְּעָן שיפוותיה ממתנייתא וכ׳</he> his lips trembled (in astonishment) at the erudition of &c.; (Ar. <he>מרתע ממתנ׳</he> he trembled &c.).

<cite ref="Eruvin 67a:4">Ib.</cite> <he>מרתע כוליה גופיה מפילפולא וכ׳</he> his whole body shook (in wonder) at the ingenious argument of &c.; (Ar. s. v. <cite ref="T01116"><he>רת</he></cite>: <he>מרתת</he>).

senses.gloss: to bubble, boil. Targ. II Esth. I, 2 (3) וחמא … דמִירְתַּע בארעא and Nebuchadnezzar saw his (Zechariah’s) blood bubbling in the ground (Gitt. 57ᵇ מרתח).
